mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_REPORT ( REPORT_NO , MEMBER_NO , BOARD_NO , REPORT_CATEGORY , REPORT_TITLE , REPORT_CONTENT , STATUS , REPORT_DATE , REPORT_STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_REPORT_NO.NEXTVAL , #{memberNo} , #{boardNo} , #{reportCategory} , #{reportTitle} , #{reportContent} , DEFAULT , SYSDATE , DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_NO reportNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , BOARD_NO boardNo , REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory , REPORT_TITLE reportTitle , REPORT_CONTENT reportContent , STATUS , REPORT_DATE reportDate FROM TB_REPORT WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY REPORT_NO

SELECT REPORT_NO reportNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , BOARD_NO boardNo , REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory , REPORT_TITLE reportTitle , REPORT_CONTENT reportContent , STATUS , REPORT_DATE reportDate FROM TB_REPORT WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'Y' AND (REPORT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR REPORT_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') ORDER BY REPORT_NO

SELECT REPORT_NO reportNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , BOARD_NO boardNo , REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory , REPORT_TITLE reportTitle , REPORT_CONTENT reportContent , STATUS , REPORT_DATE reportDate FROM TB_REPORT WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'Y' AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY REPORT_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'Y' AND REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
UPDATE TB_REPORT SET REPORT_STATUS = 'N' WHERE REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_NO reportNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , BOARD_NO boardNo , REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory , REPORT_TITLE reportTitle , REPORT_CONTENT reportContent , STATUS , REPORT_DATE reportDate FROM TB_REPORT WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'Y' AND REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REPORT WHERE REPORT_STATUS = 'Y' AND MEMBER_NO = #{param1} AND BOARD_NO = #{param2}
